texts.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some significant progress on the back of this stroke of luck.

texts.zh: 我们已经成功地获取了数艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]舰船间对话的清晰音频讯号。在我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还不能准确认识他们所记录下的单词的含义，但他们对于这段新的信号将会对突破带来重大进展抱有信心。
texts.en: We have managed to pick up a clear audio feed of conversations between several [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ships. While our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are still none the wiser as to the meanings of any of the words they are recording, they are optimistic that this new signal will help them make significant progress towards a breakthrough.

summary.text:
# 发现清晰信号 / Clear Signal Found
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触随机插曲 first-contact random interlude
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_random_events.txt:15-36` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:1257-1795`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次接触阶段进度检定失败时（on_roll_failed → standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed）：先给线索，再有 1/20 概率从阶段指定的事件池里按权重抽一个，同一站点 125 天内最多触发一次（flag first_contact_event_fired）（`first_contact_effects.txt:1257–1294`）。本事件在以下池中：早期事件池 early_fc_random_events（默认第一阶段、掠夺者/海盗/商队/游牧民的第一阶段） 权重2。/ When a stage progress roll fails (on_roll_failed → standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed): clues are added, then a 1-in-20 chance draws one event from the stage’s pool by weight, at most once per 125 days per site. This event sits in: early pool (default stage 1 and the stage 1 of marauders, pirates, caravaneers, nomads) weight 2。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**发现一个格外清晰的重复信号（5000）**：语言学家获得好材料，+2 阶段线索。 / An especially clear repeating signal: +2 stage clues.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单选项（“很好”）。 / Single option.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无额外条件，只受“一次”标志限制。 / Only the once-per-site flag restricts it. 每个站点每个事件最多一次（flag fc_event_5000 或同类标记）。/ Once per site.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：脚本、scripted effect 中各池的权重与零权重条件、standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed。/ Script, per-pool weights and exclusions, and the roll-failure wrapper.
- 审阅改动 Changes：无结构改动（独立插曲页）；补充了触发池与条件。/ No structural change; trigger pools and conditions added.
